profiles.scope: Use already registered CAP-PHARMACY for pharmacy participation, branches, schedules, pharmacy-maintained offers/prices/inventory, reservation, fulfillment and dispense records. CDS owns interaction and dose advice, AI supplies separately governed forecasts. Existing Medication source 403 is referenced, never remigrated.
